system.description:
Hill Dwarf

Hill dwarves are closely related to their mountain-dwelling kin but have adapted to life on the surface and in the rolling foothills rather than deep underground. They tend to be slightly shorter and less robust than mountain dwarves, and their complexions are somewhat lighter due to more frequent exposure to sunlight. Hill dwarves are somewhat more comfortable in dealings with surface races and are thus slightly more open and sociable, though still dour by most standards. They mine the hills and lowland mines rather than the great mountain holds.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Detect Stonework: Detect grade/slope on 1–4 in d6; new construction on 1–4; sliding walls on 1–3; stonework traps on 1–3; depth underground on 1–2.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. orcs, half-orcs, goblins, and hobgoblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. giants, ogres, trolls, ogre magi, and titans.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +1 per 3.5 points of Constitution vs. magic and poison.
  • Surface Adaptability: Hill dwarves are more comfortable on the surface world and do not suffer the restlessness that mountain dwarves experience after extended time above ground.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief multiclass.
